mechanism: Both drugs are hepatically metabolized and gemfibrozil may inhibit CYP3A4/2C9, potentially increasing disulfiram levels; disulfiram also has hepatotoxic potential which may be additive with gemfibrozil.
action: Monitor liver function tests and watch for signs of hepatotoxicity; consider alternative fibrate if possible or dose adjustment of disulfiram; counsel patient on alcohol avoidance.
